lines.text: Ava reached the cold summit tired and slow.
Her water bottle was still full, buried at the bottom of her pack.
Cold days hide thirst, so she forgot to drink.
Carry the bottle at your hip in an insulated sleeve on a strap,
and take a few sips at every stop.
The sleeve also slows the water from freezing.
Ava drank on the way down.
Save this before your next winter hike.
